typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		Document_Control_Number as string,
		Transaction_ID as string,
		Request_Number as string,
		Sender_ID as string,
		Submitter_ID as string,
		Provider_NPI as string,
		Provider_Tax_ID as string,
		Provider_Org_Name as string,
		Provider_First_Name as string,
		Provider_Last_Name as string,
		Provider_State as string,
		Facets_Group_ID as string,
		Product_Type as string,
		Subscriber_ID as string,
		Subscriber_Prefix_ID as string,
		Patient_Account_Number as string,
		Date_Of_Birth as date,
		Patient_First_Name as string,
		Patient_Last_Name as string,
		Member_Plan_State as string,
		Claim_ID as string,
		DOS_From as date,
		DOS_To as date,
		Claim_Amount as integer,
		Doc_Type as string,
		Doc_Type_Reporting as string,
		LOINC as string,
		Document_Type_ID as integer,
		Document_Type as string,
		Document_UID as long,
		Document_ID as string,
		Document_Description as string,
		File_Extension as string,
		Document_Date as date,
		Document_Creation_Date as timestamp,
		Availity_Filename as string,
		Source_System as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	format: 'table',
	staged:false) ~> Macess
Macess derive({Copy of Document_UID} = toString(Document_UID)) ~> DataConversion1
DataConversion1 derive({Copy of Document_ID} = toString(Document_ID),
		{Copy of Document_Type} = toString(Document_Type),
		{Copy of Document_Description} = toString(Document_Description),
		{Copy of Doc_Type_Reporting} = toString(Doc_Type_Reporting)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		Request_Number as string,
		Claim_Number as string,
		Document_ID as string,
		Facets_Group_ID as string,
		Provider_NPI as string,
		Document_UID as string,
		Document_Type as string,
		DCN as string,
		Provider_Org_Name as string,
		Member_First_Name as string,
		Subscriber_ID as string,
		Submitter_ID as string,
		Document_Description as string,
		Doc_Type_Reporting as string,
		Doc_Type as string,
		Member_Last_Name as string,
		Sender_ID as string,
		Patient_Account_Number as string,
		Document_Type_ID as long,
		Provider_Tax_ID as string,
		Record_Received_Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Transaction_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		Request_Number,
		Claim_Number = Claim_ID,
		Document_ID = {Copy of Document_ID},
		Facets_Group_ID,
		Provider_NPI,
		Document_UID,
		Document_Type = {Copy of Document_Type},
		DCN = Document_Control_Number,
		Provider_Org_Name,
		Member_First_Name = Patient_First_Name,
		Subscriber_ID,
		Submitter_ID,
		Document_Description = {Copy of Document_Description},
		Doc_Type_Reporting = {Copy of Doc_Type_Reporting},
		Doc_Type,
		Member_Last_Name = Patient_Last_Name,
		Sender_ID,
		Patient_Account_Number,
		Document_Type_ID,
		Provider_Tax_ID,
		Record_Received_Date = Document_Creation_Date,
		Transaction_ID)) ~> OLEDBDestination
